content: MinIO moved core server to AGPLv3 in 2021, and through 2025 progressively stripped admin/management features from the free Community Edition web console into a paid product, then entered maintenance mode (one source: archived April 2026). Not recommended for new self-hosted projects. Apache-2.0 alternative: SeaweedFS (mature, 12+ years, Go, S3-compatible). AGPL alternative: Garage (fine for non-distributed software, viral license risk if embedded).
